note: Unit cards for the CER-01 app + site. Edit here; sync.yml adds live versions and status from each repo.

units.d: Plans the cheapest grocery run across nearby stores: deals, routes, a list in drive order.
b: Cheapest stop wins: every stop prices a skipped item.
Pointless runs fade out with a “Not worth it” pill.
Run spots look 30 km then 60 km and retry.
A swap store must win at least one item.

units.d: Echo tells each home when to open the windows. Runs every 15 min from GitHub Actions.
b: Multi-home: one home per secret, one broken home never stops the others.
Setup page in French first, English toggle.
Logs show private ids only, never names or codes.
Echo Show screen text and weather titles.
units.nv: Latest alert run waits for approval in Actions. Alerts are paused until then.
tu: Shows the last alert run first.
Fires the workflow for one or all homes.
Lists homes by name, never codes.
pytest, rebuild, push: main is live.

units.d: Workbench for a Québec CPA firm: Tauri app for Windows and Android, encrypted vault, Drive sync.
b: Engagements with stage gates, year-end file, time and billing.
Encrypted local vault, Windows Hello first, auto-lock after 10 min.
Encrypted 3-way sync through your own Google Drive.
Unsigned Windows and Android builds from CI.

units.d: Drives the Fire TV Stick and the Samsung TV from the PC over adb: remote keys, apps, debloat, a clean Projectivy home.
b: 32 Amazon apps debloated; restore puts them back.
UX preset: animations 0.5x, ad tracking and usage data off.
Projectivy home: one Watch row of 9 apps, Amazon rows hidden.
